ValidationRule.description: Haversine (SIN/COS/ATAN2/SQRT/PI) must agree with DISTANCE for international shipments; box dimensions pass ATAN/ASIN/ACOS/TAN sanity bands; volume and density pass LOG/EXP checks; transit speed must be physically possible.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Origin__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Destination__latitude__s)), OR( AND( Is_International__c, ABS(3958.8 * 2 * ATAN2(SQRT((SIN((Destination__latitude__s - Origin__latitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2 + COS(Origin__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * COS(Destination__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * SIN((Destination__longitude__s - Origin__longitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2)), SQRT(1 - (SIN((Destination__latitude__s - Origin__latitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2 + COS(Origin__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * COS(Destination__latitude__s * PI() / 180) * SIN((Destination__longitude__s - Origin__longitude__s) * PI() / 360) ^ 2))) - DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'mi')) > 0.05 * MAX(1, DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'mi')) ), AND( NULLVALUE(Length_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NULLVALUE(Width_Cm__c, 0) > 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Height_Cm__c)), OR( ATAN(Height_Cm__c / Length_Cm__c) * 180 / PI() > 80, ASIN(MIN(1, Width_Cm__c / MAX(Length_Cm__c, Width_Cm__c, Height_Cm__c))) < ACOS(0.99), ROUND(TAN(ATAN(Width_Cm__c / Length_Cm__c)) * Length_Cm__c, 1) <> ROUND(Width_Cm__c, 1), AND( NULLVALUE(Volume_M3__c, 0) > 0, OR( ABS(Volume_M3__c - Length_Cm__c * Width_Cm__c * Height_Cm__c / 1000000) > 0.02 * Volume_M3__c, LOG(NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0) / Volume_M3__c + 1) > LOG(20000), NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0) / Volume_M3__c < EXP(0) ) ) ) ), AND( NULLVALUE(Transit_Seconds__c, 0) > 0, DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'mi') / (Transit_Seconds__c / 3600) > IF(ISPICKVAL(Service_Level__c, 'Ground'), 80, 600) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipment geometry, volume/density or transit speed is implausible.
